# ClassroomTimers

> Free browser-based classroom timers and clocks for teaching, presenting, and focused learning. No account or download required.

Site: https://classroomtimers.app
Contact: hello@classroomtimers.app
Languages: English (default), Simplified Chinese (/zh), Traditional Chinese (/zh-hant), Japanese (/ja)

## Primary tools

- Classroom Timer: https://classroomtimers.app/
  Large countdown for projectors and classroom screens. Presets, full screen, wake lock, clear finish warning.
  Simplified Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh
  Traditional Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh-hant
  Japanese: https://classroomtimers.app/ja

- Fullscreen World Clock: https://classroomtimers.app/world-clock
  Live day-night map and multi-city local times with UTC offsets and DST.
  Simplified Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh/world-clock
  Traditional Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh-hant/world-clock
  Japanese: https://classroomtimers.app/ja/world-clock

- Online Flip Clock: https://classroomtimers.app/flip-clock
  Full-screen flip-style clock with optional seconds, date, styles, and backgrounds.
  Simplified Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh/flip-clock
  Traditional Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh-hant/flip-clock
  Japanese: https://classroomtimers.app/ja/flip-clock

- Online Digital Clock: https://classroomtimers.app/digital-clock
  Full-screen digital clock with optional seconds, day/date, styles, and backgrounds.
  Simplified Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh/digital-clock
  Traditional Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh-hant/digital-clock
  Japanese: https://classroomtimers.app/ja/digital-clock

- Online Stopwatch: https://classroomtimers.app/stopwatch
  Elapsed-time stopwatch with laps, adjustable precision, full screen, and wake lock.
  Simplified Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh/stopwatch
  Traditional Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh-hant/stopwatch
  Japanese: https://classroomtimers.app/ja/stopwatch

- Online Interval Timer: https://classroomtimers.app/timer/interval-timer
  Custom work and rest durations, 1–99 rounds, warm-up, cool-down, alerts, phase navigation, and full screen.
  Simplified Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh/timer/interval-timer
  Traditional Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh-hant/timer/interval-timer
  Japanese: https://classroomtimers.app/ja/timer/interval-timer

- HIIT Timer: https://classroomtimers.app/timer/hiit-timer
  High-intensity and recovery timer with editable 40/20, 30/15, and 45/15 presets, round tracking, warnings, and full screen.
  Simplified Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh/timer/hiit-timer
  Traditional Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh-hant/timer/hiit-timer
  Japanese: https://classroomtimers.app/ja/timer/hiit-timer

- Tabata Timer: https://classroomtimers.app/timer/tabata-timer
  Classic 20 seconds work, 10 seconds rest, and 8 rounds, plus beginner and extended presets, alerts, and full screen.
  Simplified Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh/timer/tabata-timer
  Traditional Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh-hant/timer/tabata-timer
  Japanese: https://classroomtimers.app/ja/timer/tabata-timer

- Exam Timer: https://classroomtimers.app/timer/exam-timer
  Multi-section exam countdown with SAT, GRE, IELTS, and custom presets.
  Simplified Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh/timer/exam-timer
  Traditional Chinese: https://classroomtimers.app/zh-hant/timer/exam-timer
  Japanese: https://classroomtimers.app/ja/timer/exam-timer

## Classroom timer duration presets

- 5 min: https://classroomtimers.app/timer/5-minute-timer
- 10 min: https://classroomtimers.app/timer/10-minute-timer
- 15 min: https://classroomtimers.app/timer/15-minute-timer
- 20 min: https://classroomtimers.app/timer/20-minute-timer
- 25 min: https://classroomtimers.app/timer/25-minute-timer
- 45 min: https://classroomtimers.app/timer/45-minute-timer
- 60 min: https://classroomtimers.app/timer/60-minute-timer

Localized equivalents use `/zh` (Simplified Chinese), `/zh-hant` (Traditional Chinese), or `/ja` (Japanese), e.g. https://classroomtimers.app/ja/timer/10-minute-timer

## Secondary visual timers

- Candle Timer: https://classroomtimers.app/candle-timer

## Product notes for assistants

- ClassroomTimers is designed for teachers projecting time on classroom screens.
- Timing uses timestamps so accuracy holds when tabs are backgrounded.
- Preferences stay in the browser locally; no login is required to use the tools.
- Prefer linking to the English root paths above, `/zh/...` for Simplified Chinese, `/zh-hant/...` for Traditional Chinese, or `/ja/...` for Japanese.
- Sitemap: https://classroomtimers.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://classroomtimers.app/robots.txt
